business_problem: A.S.O. wanted a new way to engage a broader international audience with personalized content and data about the Tour de France.
solution_summary: Inside My Race, developed jointly by Capgemini and A.S.O., ingests more than 20 live and historical race-data and content feeds and fuses them in real time with contextual information. Its AI editorial engine and AI agents track riders and teams, generate personalized stage narratives and retrospective summaries, translate them into four languages, and review outputs; self-healing AI checks data and moderates generated content to improve speed and accuracy. Fans can filter by rider, nationality, team, or position and receive text, data, photo, and video stories. The experience refreshes every two minutes and is delivered through the Tour de France official website and mobile app. The story does not identify storage technology or describe a persistence layer, so none is inferred.
